components.title: Plenary Panels
components.desc: High-level discussions featuring global leaders, policymakers, and cultural experts addressing critical intersections of culture and sustainability.

components.title: Community Roundtables
components.desc: Grassroots-led sessions where community practitioners share lived experiences and locally-driven resilience strategies.

components.title: Cultural Expositions
components.desc: Showcasing traditional arts, crafts, and cultural practices from diverse communities, celebrating cultural diversity and innovation.

components.title: Youth Forums
components.desc: Dedicated spaces for young leaders to present innovative solutions and shape the future of cultural resilience.

components.title: Research Presentations
components.desc: Academic and community-based research on cultural resilience, sustainability, and Indigenous knowledge systems.

components.title: Thematic Working Groups
components.desc: Collaborative sessions developing actionable strategies and commitments for each of the six thematic pillars.

sessions.title: Registration & Welcome Coffee
sessions.desc: Welcome reception with refreshments and networking opportunities. Collect your conference materials and connect with fellow delegates.

sessions.title: Opening Ceremony & Keynote Address
sessions.desc: Welcome addresses from co-organizers, Indigenous acknowledgment, and keynote on cultural resilience and care transformation in the 21st century.

sessions.title: Plenary Panel: Bridging Culture, Care & Climate
sessions.desc: Global leaders discuss integrating cultural perspectives into climate action and care industry transformation.

sessions.title: Parallel Thematic Workshops: Culture & Care Integration
sessions.desc: Deep-dive sessions on Climate Justice, Culture-Based Trade, and Cultural Approaches to Care.

sessions.title: Community Roundtables: Care for Caregivers
sessions.desc: Grassroots leaders share community-led resilience initiatives and cultural heritage perspectives on care.

sessions.title: Plenary: Indigenous Knowledge & Care Systems
sessions.desc: Indigenous leaders present traditional knowledge as solutions to contemporary care and environmental challenges.

sessions.title: Parallel Workshops: Redefining Care Industry
sessions.desc: Sessions on Cultural Transformative Values for Care, Senior Participation in Decision-Making, and Technology Integration.

sessions.title: Youth Forum: Next Generation Leadership in Care
sessions.desc: Young leaders present innovative approaches to cultural resilience and care transformation.

sessions.title: Research Presentations: Culture Meets Care
sessions.desc: Academic and community researchers share findings on cultural approaches to care industry innovation.

sessions.title: Optional: Working Group Sessions
sessions.desc: Final collaborative sessions for action planning and commitments.

sessions.title: Sydney Cultural & Tourism Experience
sessions.desc: Guided tours of Sydney's iconic landmarks: Opera House, Harbour Bridge, Royal Botanic Gardens, and cultural sites. Experience Australia's vibrant multicultural heritage.

sessions.title: Optional: Sunset Harbour Cruise
sessions.desc: Relaxing cruise on Sydney Harbour with networking opportunities.

sessions.title: Farewell Dinner (Optional)
sessions.desc: Closing celebration with Australian cuisine and cultural performances.
